notes: Declared before the form II rule: a form I sample carrying Ss_methylase (phase-variable antigen OFF) satisfies both at 1.0 and the exact_set tie resolves by declaration order
Form II: the form-I antigen is phase-variable via Ss_methylase and no panel wzx is detected (ShigaTyper checkpoint semantics)
Sd1_rfp intact; an rfp-negative strain (phenotypically antigen-1-negative, ShigaTyper reports 'rfp-') needs its own Sd1_wzx-only rule in a full panel
Catch-all for the S. flexneri base without a listed conversion set: with a full gtr/Oac panel this splits into Y (no conversion genes) and ShigaTyper's 'novel serotype' (unlisted conversion set)

Approximation of ShigaTyper checkpoint 3 (Wu et al. 2019, Appl Environ Microbiol 85:e00165-19): EIEC = lacY+ with the S. boydii 9/15 exemptions excluded; cadA and ipaB plasmid-coverage nuances are not modelled
